I was a part of Reddit near the start. People were generally thoughtful and encouraged civil discourse. The front pages were full of the very best content, and trash seemed non-existent. Stuff that was mentally challenging and informative. At that time, I felt surrounded by peers that were genuinely brilliant and very kind. It challenged me want to be a better person.

The Reddit we know now does just the opposite. It's about arguing to win, not arguing to learn. The content is extremely immature and brain-numbingly dumb. It's also repetitive beyond hope. It pulls you into the muck, so you must fight that while working hard to enjoy the content.

I had given up on the general content of Reddit, and was focused on some core subreddits. That worked somewhat, as long as the subreddits weren't controversial. Even still, nearly every post with a high enough score to reach the front page would turn into a shit storm that was frustrating to read.

Given that, I had hoped that voat.co would be like starting fresh again. It isn't. The front page is increasingly full of content I find uninspiring and repetitively dull.

Perhaps it will grow to something better.
